description: Grade MCP tool definitions (the tools array from a tools/list result) for how well AI agents can pick and call them. Returns a 0–100 score and A–F grade, per-tool scores, and findings with concrete fixes: missing or weak descriptions, untyped parameters, strings without maxLength, missing required or additionalProperties, missing annotations (readOnlyHint, destructiveHint …), invalid or duplicate names, outputSchema and enum problems, hidden characters and tool-poisoning patterns. Also returns an ESTIMATED token cost of the definitions (characters ÷ 4; real counts vary by model). Pure parsing: no network calls, and your tool definitions are never stored. Read-only. Same engine as the ToolGrade JSON API (POST /api/grade).

include_raw.description: Also return the full /api/grade report (all findings and every tool row) in structuredContent.raw. Larger output.

tools.description: The tool definitions to grade, e.g. [{"name": "search_docs", "description": "...", "inputSchema": {...}}]: the "tools" array of a tools/list result. Up to 200 tools. Provide this or tools_json.

items.description: One MCP tool definition (name, description, inputSchema, optional title, annotations, outputSchema).

tools_json.description: Alternative to tools: raw JSON text of a tools/list response, its result object ({"tools": [...]}) or a tool array, exactly as copied.

name: grade_tools

estimatedTokens.description: ESTIMATED total token cost of all definitions (compact JSON chars ÷ 4).

tool.description: Tool name (from the submitted input; untrusted). Omitted for server-wide findings.

raw.description: Full /api/grade response (only when include_raw is true)

title: Grade MCP tool definitions for agent-readiness
